newsitem.title: USA: Milestone Props agrees to settlement.
newsitem.headline: Milestone Props agrees to settlement.

text.p: Milestone Properties Inc said on Tuesday that it had reached a tentative agreement to a proposed settlement of a lawsuit pending in Delaware Chancery Court brought by a preferred stockholder.

"In connection with the proposed settlement, Milestone would pay each of its preferred stockholders at the time of settlement $0.75 per share, and each share of Milestone preferred stock would be exchanged for a new preferred stock to be issued by a subsidiary of Concord Assets Group," the company said.
The claim relates to Milestone's 1995 acquisition of properties from its affiliate Concord and the spinoff of Union Property Investors Inc.

In addition each share of Milestone preferred stock would be exchanged for a new preferred stock to be issued by a subsidiary of Concord Assets Group and have $2.25 per share liquidation preference, no dividend and a mandatory redemption at the end of five years at $2.25 per share.
The settlement is subject to approval by the Delaware court, the litigants and Milestone's insurer. (--New York newsroom 212 859 1700)
